title: Queue reservation scan can observe a vanished memory-reservation file
body: During this lane's queued capture witness retry, /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh line 625 emitted ENOENT for /tmp/undertow-box-memory-reservation.4150545 while scanning reservations. The queued attempt was canceled before CTest started to avoid overlapping another DZN run; a later isolated queued invocation completed successfully. Make reservation scans tolerate files removed concurrently (for example by ignoring ENOENT per entry) so a harmless concurrent cleanup does not disrupt queue admission.
